name: list_events
description: List calendar events whose start time falls within an optional half-open time range.

start.description: Inclusive lower bound as a timezone-naive ISO-8601 local datetime, for example 2026-08-10T09:00:00.

end.description: Exclusive upper bound as a timezone-naive ISO-8601 local datetime, for example 2026-08-10T10:00:00.

start.description: Timezone-naive ISO-8601 local datetime, for example 2026-08-10T09:00:00.

end.description: Timezone-naive ISO-8601 local datetime, for example 2026-08-10T10:00:00.

name: update_event
description: Patch an existing calendar event while preserving omitted fields.

start.description: Timezone-naive ISO-8601 local datetime, for example 2026-08-10T09:00:00.

end.description: Timezone-naive ISO-8601 local datetime, for example 2026-08-10T10:00:00.

name: delete_event
description: Delete an existing calendar event by ID.

name: check_availability
description: Check whether a half-open time interval is free of calendar conflicts.

start.description: Timezone-naive ISO-8601 local datetime, for example 2026-08-10T09:00:00.

end.description: Timezone-naive ISO-8601 local datetime, for example 2026-08-10T10:00:00.
